kit: HackUTD 2026 CC0 scenery kit for a West Texas (Permian Basin) produced-water field at night
conventions: Models are GLB in meters, one root node named by id, resting on Z = 0 and centered in X and Y. size_m is [X, Y, Z] in Blender axes (Z up). The GLB itself is Y-up, so three.js sees Blender Z as Y. Root nodes carry extras scenery, license, source_url.

Poly Haven.license_evidence: https://polyhaven.com/license says: 'Our assets are all licensed as CC0' and links to creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Files and authors came from the official API (api.polyhaven.com /files and /info), with every download checked against the API md5.

assets.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)

gaps.item: Barbed wire ranch fence (posts with wire strands)
gaps.reason: No CC0 model on Poly Haven, ambientCG, or Kenney. The kit has a wooden post-and-rail fence instead. Wire strands are easy to generate in the scenery script as thin curves between posts.
